# telnyx_whatsapp_message_template (Data Source)

A WhatsApp message template of a WhatsApp Business Account. Templates are reviewed by Meta after create and after each change; status shows the outcome, and only approved templates can be used to start conversations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Template category: AUTHENTICATION, UTILITY, or MARKETING. One of `AUTHENTICATION`, `MARKETING`, `UTILITY`.
- `components` (Attributes List) Template components (header, body, footer, buttons) as submitted, including example values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components))
- `created_at` (String)
- `language` (String) Template language code (e.g. en_US, es, pt_BR).
- `name` (String) Template name. Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only.
- `record_type` (String)
- `rejection_reason` (String)
- `status` (String) Current template status from Meta (e.g. PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, PAUSED, DISABLED). Additional statuses may be returned as Meta evolves the template lifecycle.
- `template_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `waba_id` (String) The WhatsApp Business Account ID.
- `whatsapp_business_account` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--whatsapp_business_account))

<a id="nestedatt--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components`

Read-Only:

- `buttons` (Attributes List) Array of button objects. Meta supports various combinations of button types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components--buttons))
- `cards` (Attributes List) Array of card objects, each with its own components. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components--cards))
- `code_expiration_minutes` (Number) OTP code expiration time in minutes. Used in AUTHENTICATION template footers instead of free-form text.
- `example` (Attributes) Sample values for body variables. Required when body text contains parameters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components--example))
- `format` (String) Header format type: TEXT (supports one variable), IMAGE, VIDEO, DOCUMENT, or LOCATION. One of `DOCUMENT`, `IMAGE`, `LOCATION`, `TEXT`, `VIDEO`.
- `text` (String) Footer text. Maximum 60 characters. For non-authentication templates.
- `type` (String) One of `BODY`, `BUTTONS`, `CAROUSEL`, `FOOTER`, `HEADER`.

<a id="nestedatt--components--buttons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components.buttons`

Read-Only:

- `autofill_text` (String) Custom autofill button text for ONE_TAP OTP buttons.
- `example` (List of String) Sample values for URL variable.
- `flow_action` (String) Flow action type for FLOW-type buttons. One of `data_exchange`, `navigate`.
- `flow_id` (String) Flow ID for FLOW-type buttons.
- `navigate_screen` (String) Target screen name for FLOW buttons with navigate action.
- `otp_type` (String) One of `COPY_CODE`, `ONE_TAP`.
- `package_name` (String) Android package name. Required for ONE_TAP OTP buttons.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number in E.164 format.
- `signature_hash` (String) Android app signing key hash. Required for ONE_TAP OTP buttons.
- `text` (String) Button label text. Maximum 25 characters. Required for URL, PHONE_NUMBER, and QUICK_REPLY buttons. Not required for OTP buttons (Meta supplies the label).
- `type` (String) One of `COPY_CODE`, `FLOW`, `OTP`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `QUICK_REPLY`, `URL`.
- `url` (String) URL for URL-type buttons. Supports one variable ({{1}}).
- `zero_tap_terms_accepted` (Boolean) Whether zero-tap terms have been accepted.


<a id="nestedatt--components--cards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components.cards`

Read-Only:

- `components` (List of String)


<a id="nestedatt--components--example"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components.example`

Read-Only:

- `body_text` (String) Array containing one array of sample values, one per variable in order. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.

Read-Only:
